title: Security report: potential findings in graphene-django
author: leeyu44
body_preview: Hello maintainers,  I am opening this issue to establish vendor contact for a security review of graphene-django. The local report identifies the following potential security findings:  - IDOR in BaseDjangoFormMutation - HIGH - IDOR in SerializerMutation - HIGH - Mass Assignment - HIGH - All Fields Exposed by Default - MEDIUM - Debug Middleware SQL Leak - MEDIUM - GraphiQL Without Auth - MEDIUM -...

title: Optimizer: select_related preserved from the queryset is dropped from only() by a prefix match without `__` boundary
author: cordeiror
body_preview: ## Summary  `OptimizerStore._apply_select_related` tries to keep manually-applied `select_related` in the `only()` mask, but the coverage check is a raw string prefix match. When two relations on the same model share a name prefix (`empresa` / `empresa_comercial`), selecting only the longer one makes the optimizer believe the shorter one is covered.
